in_marathi.name: Ramana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rama means 'God' or 'Refuge' in Sanskrit and Hinduism. The name Ramana can be derived from Rama, which is a name of God in Hinduism. The name signifies God as the ultimate refuge and protector.
